subject: an Athenian man of the 5th century BC with a broad snub nose, wide-set bulging eyes, a balding head and a full curly beard, a sturdy build, barefoot, wearing a single plain worn wool cloak

panels.01-alopece: a small district on a hillside just outside the walls of ancient Athens around 469 BC, simple stone houses, a stoneworker's yard with blocks of marble and chisels, the Acropolis visible in the distance, olive trees, morning light, wide establishing shot
panels.02-potidaea: {S} in bronze helmet and simple hoplite armour with a round shield, standing guard outside a siege camp in winter near a walled city in northern Greece in 432 BC, other soldiers huddled by fires, he stands calm and barefoot in the cold, no violence
panels.03-delium: {S} as a stocky bearded Athenian foot soldier of 424 BC, a classical Greek hoplite with a bronze Corinthian helmet pushed back on his head, a large round bronze shield and a long spear, walking calmly in a slow retreat across a dusty Boeotian plain beside his friend, other Greek hoplites on foot around them, no horses, no knights, no medieval armour, no blood
panels.04-clouds: an open-air ancient Greek theatre in Athens in 423 BC filled with a laughing audience, on stage a comic actor in an exaggerated mask hangs in a basket among painted clouds, while {S} stands up calmly in the crowd so everyone can compare the real man to the mask
panels.05-leon: {S} walking quietly away down a street in ancient Athens at dusk in 404 BC, while behind him four other men leave a round stone building with armed guards, heading the other way toward the harbour, a moment of quiet refusal, dignified
panels.06-apology: {S} aged about seventy standing and speaking calmly before a large jury of hundreds of Athenian citizens seated on wooden benches in an open-air court in 399 BC, his accusers seated to one side, a water clock on a stand, tense and dignified
panels.07-crito: {S} aged about seventy sitting on a plain bed in a stone prison cell at dawn in 399 BC, talking earnestly with an anxious old friend in a good cloak who leans toward him, a small barred window letting in grey light, calm conversation
panels.08-phaedo: {S} aged about seventy sitting upright in a stone prison room in 399 BC, calmly holding a simple clay cup, surrounded by grieving friends and students in cloaks, a jailer standing respectfully by the door, warm late light, peaceful and dignified, not graphic
